effects.name: chromeicosahedroninterior
effects.description: A surreal view from inside a perfectly reflective chrome icosahedron. The camera slowly orbits inside the 20-faced polyhedron, watching multiple internal reflections create an infinite kaleidoscopic mirror effect. Chrome surfaces exhibit Fresnel-based reflectivity with bright glowing edges at grazing angles. A procedural environment creates surreal color bands visible in the reflections - cool metallics shifting through cyan, silver, and hints of gold. Edge glow pulses softly. Chromatic aberration adds prismatic rainbow fringing to reflections. The overall aesthetic is ethereal, metallic, and hypnotically geometric.
